messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I want a fair financial share. I haven’t agreed to a family discount and won’t subsidize one. I’d consider a sale to A at full market value if the will allows it, but no price or shares are settled. I don’t have the will wording to quote, and I don’t know B’s financial needs, whether there’s a written offer, or any deadline. I’d like this resolved, but I’m not in a hurry.

I want to buy the house with my husband, who would be on the ownership papers. I haven’t set a price or made a written offer; I’d like a family discount, but I’m willing to consider a neutral valuation and the same chance for B and C to buy at that price. I can’t provide the will’s exact wording right now. I need time to review it, and I don’t want anyone signing before independent legal review.

Thank you. I don’t have the will and haven’t seen a written offer; I only know A wants to buy. I’m not sure yet what I want for the house, but I’d like to understand what money might be available to me. I hope to use some money to start a dance studio—please keep that private for now. I don’t have a firm amount or date, and I’m not sure whether I feel pressured; I need time to see the documents.
I know of no deadline or written offer. I still want a fair share and have not agreed to a discount. I’m not in a hurry; I’ll review the will when it’s shared.
I don’t have a copy of the will, so I can’t quote it or say who holds it. I need time to find out. I’m not aware of a deadline or written offer.

I don’t have a copy and don’t know who holds the will. I don’t know of any deadline or written offer. I need time to see the documents before I can say what timing would help. Please keep the detail I marked private to yourself for now.

I don’t have a copy of the will and don’t know which lawyer wrote it, where Dad kept it, or who may have a copy. I know of no deadline or written offer. I’ll review the wording once it’s found; I’m not in a hurry.
I don’t know how long it will take to find the will. I’ll check what I can and let you know; I’m not aware of any deadline, written offer, or pressure.
I don’t know which lawyer wrote the will or where Dad kept it, and I don’t know who might have a copy. I need more time.
